content: For pediatric patients diagnosed with acute otitis media, the recommended dosage of trimethoprim is 10 mg per kilogram of body weight per 24-hour period. This total daily dose should be divided into two equal doses, administered every 12 hours, and continued for a duration of 10 days. For adults with uncomplicated urinary tract infections, the standard oral dosage is either 100 mg (equivalent to 10 mL of the liquid formulation) every 12 hours or 200 mg (equivalent to 20 mL of the liquid formulation) every 24 hours. This regimen should also be followed for a total of 10 days. In patients with impaired renal function, the administration of trimethoprim is contraindicated if the creatinine clearance is less than 15 mL/min. For those with a creatinine clearance between 15 and 30 mL/min, the dosage should be reduced to half of the standard dose recommended for individuals of the same age with normal renal function.
